name: Clean
overview: Scripture reveals that true cleanliness begins within, as Jesus rebukes the Pharisees to first cleanse the inside before the outside can be clean, emphasizing inward purity over outward appearance. Believers are made clean through the word of Christ, which purifies the heart and life. This spiritual cleansing is a plea for God to remove sin and blot out iniquities, highlighting the necessity of divine intervention for genuine purity.
